analyzed_vuln.description: UnionFromFlatbuffer deserializes flatbuffer union typeIds into int8_t without validating range/sign, then passes them to union_ / UnionType::UnionType. Negative or out-of-range values (after int32->int8 truncation) are used as indices into child_ids_ in UnionType::UnionType (child_ids_[type_code] = child_id), causing heap-buffer-overflow writes before/after the vector.
analyzed_vuln.conditions: Trigger requires an IPC stream/schema containing a Union type with crafted typeIds in flatbuffer metadata (or values that overflow when cast to int8_t). The fuzz harness arrow::ipc::internal::FuzzIpcStream -> GetSchema -> FieldFromFlatbuffer -> ConcreteTypeFromFlatbuffer -> UnionFromFlatbuffer reaches this path. Because UnionFromFlatbuffer accepts untrusted typeIds and does not reject values outside [0, UnionType::kMaxTypeCode], UnionType constructor receives invalid type_codes and performs OOB write.
